title: Avoid isatty check on abort message
detail: Use a direct write to `sys.stderr` instead of `echo`. `echo` checks `isatty()` which can raise `KeyboardInterrupt`, causing the abort message to be lost. Writing directly avoids that race condition. (PR-Agent's score: 6 of 10)

title: Add missing import and correct dedent order
detail: Import the `token` module to avoid a NameError at runtime. Also reverse the `dedents` list so that prefixes are applied in the original file order. (PR-Agent's score: 5 of 10)

title: Prevent stop on uninitialized live
detail: Guard against calling `stop()` on a potentially uninitialized `live` object. This prevents attribute errors when `Progress` is disabled before `live` is created. (PR-Agent's score: 4 of 10)

title: Incorrect scalar type check
detail: The new `_SCALAR_TYPES` set is compared using `type(value) in _SCALAR_TYPES`. This only matches exact types, so subclasses of `int`, `float`, `str`, etc. (e.g. a custom numeric type) will be incorrectly treated as non‑scalar and go through the expensive item serialization path. Using `isinstance(value, tuple(_SCALAR_TYPES))` would correctly handle subclasses.

title: Misuse of lock API
detail: The code checks `if not self._export_lock.locked:` but `locked` is a method on Twisted's `Lock` object, not an attribute. This will raise an `AttributeError` or always evaluate to `True`, causing the lock acquisition logic to malfunction and potentially lead to race conditions when exporting items.

title: Await lock acquisition consistently
detail: The lock interface uses a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. Always await the Deferred returned by `acquire()` to ensure the lock is actually acquired before proceeding. (PR-Agent's score: 8 of 10)
